content:
Hi everyone,

I'm working on a Rust UART console driver for the BL808 SoC, and I needed a small wrapper around the existing C of_alias_get_id() API.

I've currently implemented it as:

// rust/kernel/of.rs
pub fn alias_id(dev: &Device, stem: &CStr) -> Result<u32>

I have two questions:

  1. API placement: Would kernel::of be the appropriate place for this helper, or would a method on Device (e.g. Device::of_alias_id()) be preferred?

  2. Patch submission: This helper is currently part of a larger RFC series that hasn't been submitted or merged upstream yet. Since the helper is independent of the UART abstraction, would it make sense to submit it as a standalone patch first?

Current code:
https://github.com/bl808-linux/linux/tree/validation/rust-bl808-console
Patch: https://github.com/bl808-linux/linux/commit/e77bfa21499fb1200a0b420ba241cdcf8aa7c5e2

Thanks for any help!
